findings.observation: The complete display form and armour remain visible without cropping, but the hood apex and boot soles sit only a few percent from the top and bottom canvas edges, inside the required 8% exclusion zone.
Exactly one coordinated wearable armour set is shown; the Head hood, Torso cuirass, articulated Legs, and paired Boots are all readable together, with no second set or detached duplicate.
The fitted flexible hide layers, open articulation, close limb profile, and lack of rigid plate mass read immediately as mobile light armour.
Overlapping hide panels, exposed stitching, shoulder and waist straps, buckles, reinforced knees, and wrapped boots form a coherent wearable construction with plausible joins and weight.
Dark worn coarse hide dominates every armour region; neutral buckles and stitching remain subordinate and no second ranked material or rarity cue competes with it.
Rough-edged overlapping hide scales plus prominent hand stitching and creased abrasion establish coarse-hide identity through physical construction beyond the brown palette.
The F-rank set shows no supernatural emission, aura, or full-object glow; highlights remain narrow material reflections.
The render uses a cohesive premium painterly finish, honest wear, cold key light, restrained warm rim, midnight-charcoal backdrop, and grounded floor plane.

Inspection finds no transferred person or prop, published-character resemblance, rarity rainbow, gold inflation, glow, oversized silhouette, ornament-led material identity, extra gear, text, labels, UI, border, frame, logo, or watermark.
